note: 45 个统一口语场景：每场 3 条跟读句（B1+ 完整句）+ 2 道造句题（中文提示 + 标准答案）。

scenes.title: Greetings and introductions
scenes.focus: 完整句问候 + 自我介绍 + 原因扩展
openers: Good morning! How are you today?
Could you introduce yourself in a few sentences?

shadow.en: Good morning, everyone. It is really nice to meet you today.
shadow.cn: 大家早上好，今天很高兴见到你们。
shadow.tip: 先看对方再微笑，重读 nice 和 today。

shadow.en: My name is Wenwen, and I am twelve years old. I come from a small town near Shanghai.
shadow.cn: 我叫文文，今年十二岁，来自上海附近的一个小镇。
shadow.tip: 两句之间稍作停顿，town 和 Shanghai 重读。

shadow.en: I usually say hello with a smile because it makes people feel welcome.
shadow.cn: 我通常微笑着打招呼，因为这样让人感到受欢迎。
shadow.tip: because 前稍停，welcome 尾音收住。

make.prompt_cn: 告诉考官你的名字、年龄，以及你来自哪里。
make.answer: My name is Wenwen, and I am twelve years old. I come from a small town near Shanghai.

make.prompt_cn: 第一次见面时，你会怎样礼貌地打招呼？请说两句。
make.answer: Good morning! It is really nice to meet you. I hope we can have a good talk today.

scenes.title: Personal information and family
scenes.focus: 介绍家庭成员 + 职业 + 相处方式
openers: Who do you live with?
Can you tell me something about your family?

shadow.en: There are four people in my family: my parents, my younger sister and me.
shadow.cn: 我家有四口人：爸爸妈妈、妹妹和我。
shadow.tip: 列举时用降调，最后一项稍降。

shadow.en: My father is a doctor, and he often tells me interesting stories about his work.
shadow.cn: 我爸爸是医生，他常给我讲工作中有趣的故事。
shadow.tip: interesting 重音在 IN，stories 复数别漏。

shadow.en: Although my sister is only six, she already helps my mother with small chores.
shadow.cn: 虽然我妹妹才六岁，她已经会帮妈妈做些小家务。
shadow.tip: Although 引导让步，后半句重读 already。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你的家庭成员和他们的职业。
make.answer: There are four people in my family. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher, and my sister is a primary school student.

make.prompt_cn: 说说你周末通常和家人一起做什么。
make.answer: At weekends I usually cook dinner with my mother and then watch a film with my family.

scenes.title: School and study
scenes.focus: 科目与老师 + 上学方式 + 校园生活
openers: What is your favourite subject? Why?
How do you travel to school?

shadow.en: My favourite subject is English because I enjoy learning about other cultures.
shadow.cn: 我最喜欢的科目是英语，因为我喜欢了解其他文化。
shadow.tip: favourite 重音在 FAV，cultures 复数发音清晰。

shadow.en: We have maths lessons four times a week, and our teacher always makes them interesting.
shadow.cn: 我们每周有四节数学课，老师总能把课上得很有趣。
shadow.tip: four times a week 连读自然，interesting 重读 IN。

shadow.en: I usually finish school at half past four and then go to the library to read.
shadow.cn: 我通常四点半放学，然后去图书馆看书。
shadow.tip: half past four 连读，library 重音在 LI。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你最喜欢的科目和原因。
make.answer: My favourite subject is English because it is useful and I enjoy learning about other countries.

make.prompt_cn: 描述你每天怎么去学校，以及路上要花多久。
make.answer: I usually go to school by bus, and it takes me about twenty minutes.

scenes.title: Daily life and routines
scenes.focus: 作息 + 课后安排 + 周末活动
openers: What do you usually do on a school day?
What did you do last weekend?

shadow.en: On school days I get up at seven and have breakfast with my family.
shadow.cn: 上学日我七点起床，和家人一起吃早饭。
shadow.tip: school days 连读，seven 重读。

shadow.en: After school I usually do my homework before I play with my friends.
shadow.cn: 放学后我通常先做作业，再和朋友玩。
shadow.tip: before 前稍停，homework 重音在 HOME。

shadow.en: At weekends I help my parents clean the house and then relax at home.
shadow.cn: 周末我帮爸妈打扫房子，然后在家休息。
shadow.tip: At weekends 连读，relax 重音在后。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你上学日的一天安排。
make.answer: On school days I get up at seven, go to school at half past seven, and do my homework after dinner.

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你上个周末做了什么。
make.answer: Last weekend I visited my grandparents and helped them pick fruit in their garden.

scenes.title: Clothes and shopping
scenes.focus: 穿着偏好 + 购物场所 + 旧衣处理
openers: Do you like buying clothes?
What do you do with your old clothes?

shadow.en: I prefer casual clothes such as jeans and T-shirts because they are comfortable.
shadow.cn: 我更喜欢牛仔裤、T恤这类休闲装，因为穿着舒服。
shadow.tip: prefer 重音在后，comfortable 三个音节都清晰。

shadow.en: There are several clothes shops near my home, so it is easy to buy what I need.
shadow.cn: 我家附近有好几家服装店，所以买需要的东西很方便。
shadow.tip: several 重音在 SEV，shops 复数别漏。

shadow.en: I usually give my old clothes to charity instead of throwing them away.
shadow.cn: 我通常把旧衣服捐给慈善机构，而不是扔掉。
shadow.tip: instead of 连读，throwing 注意 th 音。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你更喜欢休闲装还是正装，以及原因。
make.answer: I prefer casual clothes because they are comfortable and I can move easily in them.

make.prompt_cn: 旧衣服你会怎么处理？
make.answer: I usually give my old clothes to a charity shop so that other children can wear them.

scenes.title: Food and drink
scenes.focus: 最爱食物 + 健康饮食 + 家庭用餐
openers: What is your favourite food?
Do you eat out often?

shadow.en: My favourite food is dumplings because my grandmother makes them every New Year.
shadow.cn: 我最喜欢的食物是饺子，因为奶奶每年过年都包。
shadow.tip: dumplings 复数，every New Year 连读。

shadow.en: I try to eat more vegetables and fruit, although I sometimes want sweet drinks.
shadow.cn: 我尽量多吃蔬菜水果，虽然有时也想喝甜饮料。
shadow.tip: although 引导让步，vegetables 重音在 VEG。

shadow.en: We usually have dinner together at half past six and talk about our day.
shadow.cn: 我们通常六点半一起吃晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。
shadow.tip: together 重音在 GE，talk about 连读。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你最喜欢的一道菜和它的味道。
make.answer: My favourite dish is sweet and sour pork because it tastes delicious and my mother cooks it well.

make.prompt_cn: 说说健康饮食应该包括什么。
make.answer: A healthy diet should include plenty of vegetables, fruit and water, and we should eat less junk food.

scenes.title: Hobbies and free time
scenes.focus: 爱好 + 频率 + 放松原因
openers: What do you like doing in your free time?
How often do you do it?

shadow.en: In my free time I enjoy drawing cartoons because it helps me relax after school.
shadow.cn: 空闲时我喜欢画漫画，因为能帮我在放学后放松。
shadow.tip: free time 连读，cartoons 重音在后。

shadow.en: I have been learning the guitar for two years, and I practise for thirty minutes every day.
shadow.cn: 我学吉他两年了，每天练三十分钟。
shadow.tip: have been learning 连读，practise 重音在 PRAC。

shadow.en: When the weather is fine, I ride my bike around the park with my friends.
shadow.cn: 天气好的时候，我和朋友在公园骑车。
shadow.tip: weather 注意 th，around 重音在后。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍一个你的爱好，以及你多久做一次。
make.answer: I enjoy playing basketball, and I play it with my classmates twice a week.

make.prompt_cn: 说说你放学后通常做什么。
make.answer: After school I usually finish my homework first and then play with my friends in the park.

scenes.title: Home and housework
scenes.focus: 居住环境 + 最喜欢的房间 + 家务分工
openers: What is your favourite room?
Do you help with housework?

shadow.en: I live in a flat on the fifth floor with my parents and my brother.
shadow.cn: 我和爸妈、哥哥住在五楼的一套公寓里。
shadow.tip: fifth floor 连读，flat 短音。

shadow.en: My favourite room is the kitchen because it is always warm and full of good smells.
shadow.cn: 我最喜欢的房间是厨房，因为那里总是很温暖，满是香味。
shadow.tip: favourite 重音在 FAV，smells 复数。

shadow.en: I make my bed every morning and help wash the dishes after dinner.
shadow.cn: 我每天早上整理床铺，晚饭后帮忙洗碗。
shadow.tip: make my bed 连读，dishes 重音在 DISH。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你家的房子和你最喜欢的房间。
make.answer: I live in a flat with three bedrooms. My favourite room is the living room because it is bright and we often talk there.

make.prompt_cn: 说说你在家帮忙做哪些家务。
make.answer: I make my bed every morning, and at weekends I help my mother clean the floor.

scenes.title: Travel and holidays
scenes.focus: 旅行经历 + 出行方式 + 行前准备
openers: Where did you go last summer?
How do you prefer to travel?

shadow.en: Last summer I travelled to Sanya with my family and we stayed there for a week.
shadow.cn: 去年夏天我和家人去了三亚，在那里待了一周。
shadow.tip: travelled 重音在 TRAV，stayed 尾音 d 轻。

shadow.en: I prefer travelling by train because I can enjoy the view and walk around.
shadow.cn: 我更喜欢坐火车旅行，因为可以欣赏风景、走动。
shadow.tip: prefer 重音在后，enjoy the view 连读。

shadow.en: Before a trip I always make a list of things I need so that I do not forget anything.
shadow.cn: 旅行前我总会列一份需要带的东西，以免忘带。
shadow.tip: so that 连读，forget anything 连读。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你上一次旅行去了哪里、做了什么。
make.answer: Last summer I went to Sanya with my family. We swam in the sea and visited a small island.

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你最喜欢的出行方式及原因。
make.answer: I prefer travelling by train because it is comfortable and I can see the countryside.

scenes.title: Places and hometown
scenes.focus: 家乡介绍 + 推荐地点 + 感受
openers: Can you tell me something about your hometown?
What is the best place to visit there?

shadow.en: My hometown is a quiet city with a long river and many green parks.
shadow.cn: 我的家乡是一座安静的城市，有长长的河流和许多绿色公园。
shadow.tip: hometown 重音在 HOME，quiet 两个音节。

shadow.en: The best place to visit is the old bridge, which was built more than two hundred years ago.
shadow.cn: 最值得去的地方是那座古桥，它建于两百多年前。
shadow.tip: which 从句语调稍降，two hundred 连读。

shadow.en: Although my hometown is small, it has a friendly atmosphere that visitors love.
shadow.cn: 虽然我的家乡很小，但有游客喜爱的友好氛围。
shadow.tip: Although 引导让步，atmosphere 重音在 AT。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你的家乡以及一个值得去的地方。
make.answer: My hometown is a small city near the sea. The best place to visit is the old market, where you can buy fresh seafood.

make.prompt_cn: 说说你家附近你最喜欢的地方。
make.answer: My favourite place near my home is the park, because I can run and read there.

scenes.title: Music and media
scenes.focus: 音乐偏好 + 电视节目 + 屏幕时间
openers: What kind of music do you like?
What TV programme do you watch?

shadow.en: I enjoy listening to pop music because the songs are full of energy.
shadow.cn: 我喜欢听流行音乐，因为歌曲充满活力。
shadow.tip: listening to 连读，energy 重音在 EN。

shadow.en: My favourite TV programme is a nature show that teaches me about animals.
shadow.cn: 我最喜欢的电视节目是自然节目，它教我了解动物。
shadow.tip: programme 重音在 PRO，nature show 连读。

shadow.en: I think we should spend less time on our phones and more time reading books.
shadow.cn: 我认为我们应该少花时间看手机，多花时间读书。
shadow.tip: should 弱读，reading books 连读。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你最喜欢的音乐类型和原因。
make.answer: I like pop music because it is lively and it makes me feel happy.

make.prompt_cn: 说说你最喜欢的电视节目或电影。
make.answer: My favourite film is a cartoon about a brave girl, because the story is exciting and funny.

scenes.title: Social interaction and friends
scenes.focus: 朋友介绍 + 共同活动 + 处理分歧
openers: Who is your best friend?
What do you usually do together?

shadow.en: My best friend is kind and patient, and she always listens when I have a problem.
shadow.cn: 我最好的朋友善良又有耐心，我有问题时她总会倾听。
shadow.tip: patient 重音在 PA，problem 重音在 PRO。

shadow.en: We often play basketball together after school and share our homework on the phone.
shadow.cn: 我们放学后常一起打篮球，还会在电话里交流作业。
shadow.tip: basketball 重音在 BAS，together 重音在 GE。

shadow.en: If a friend makes me angry, I try to talk to him calmly instead of shouting.
shadow.cn: 如果朋友惹我生气，我会试着平静地和他谈，而不是大喊。
shadow.tip: angry 重音在 AN，instead of 连读。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你最好的朋友以及你们常一起做什么。
make.answer: My best friend is Lin, and we often play football and do our homework together.

make.prompt_cn: 朋友之间意见不同时，你会怎么办？
make.answer: If we have different ideas, I will listen to my friend first and then explain my own opinion.

scenes.title: Sports and health
scenes.focus: 运动习惯 + 热身安全 + 健康方式
openers: What sport do you like?
How do you keep healthy?

shadow.en: I play badminton twice a week because it keeps me healthy and happy.
shadow.cn: 我每周打两次羽毛球，因为它让我健康又开心。
shadow.tip: badminton 重音在第一音节，healthy 注意 th。

shadow.en: Our P.E. teacher tells us to warm up before running so that we do not get hurt.
shadow.cn: 体育老师让我们跑步前热身，以免受伤。
shadow.tip: warm up 连读，hurt 尾音 t 轻。

shadow.en: Although I am not good at swimming, I am learning it this summer.
shadow.cn: 虽然我不擅长游泳，今年夏天正在学。
shadow.tip: Although 引导让步，swimming 双 m 音。

make.prompt_cn: 介绍你喜欢的运动以及多久做一次。
make.answer: I like playing table tennis, and I play it three times a week after school.

make.prompt_cn: 说说怎样才能保持健康。
make.answer: To keep healthy, we should exercise every day, eat more vegetables and sleep for eight hours.

scenes.title: Nature and environment
scenes.focus: 环保行动 + 节约资源 + 个人责任
openers: What can we do to protect the environment?
How do you save water at home?

shadow.en: We should sort our rubbish so that more materials can be recycled.
shadow.cn: 我们应该分类垃圾，让更多材料能被回收。
shadow.tip: rubbish 重音在 RUB，recycled 重音在 CY。

shadow.en: My class planted ten trees last spring, and we take turns watering them.
shadow.cn: 去年春天我们班种了十棵树，大家轮流浇水。
shadow.tip: planted 尾音 d 轻，take turns 连读。

shadow.en: If everyone turns off the lights when leaving a room, we can save a lot of energy.
shadow.cn: 如果每个人离开房间时关灯，我们能省很多能源。
shadow.tip: turns off 连读，energy 重音在 EN。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你在家怎样节约用水用电。
make.answer: I turn off the tap when I brush my teeth and switch off the lights when I leave my room.

make.prompt_cn: 为了保护环境，你认为最重要的一件事是什么？
make.answer: I think sorting rubbish is the most important thing, because it helps us recycle paper and plastic.

scenes.title: Classroom and study
scenes.focus: 四步法：整体 → 人物 → 位置 → 猜测
openers: Please describe the picture: a teacher helping students in a classroom.

shadow.en: In the picture, a teacher is helping two students with their work at a desk.
shadow.cn: 照片里，一位老师正在桌边帮助两名学生做作业。
shadow.tip: helping 重音在 HELP，at a desk 连读。

shadow.en: The boy on the left is writing carefully while the girl next to him is listening.
shadow.cn: 左边的男孩正在认真写字，他旁边的女孩在听。
shadow.tip: carefully 重音在 CARE，while 弱读。

shadow.en: They look interested because the teacher is explaining something in a friendly way.
shadow.cn: 他们看起来很有兴趣，因为老师正用友好的方式讲解。
shadow.tip: interested 重音在 IN，explaining 重音在 PLAIN。

make.prompt_cn: 照片里，一位老师正在教室里帮助学生做作业。
make.answer: In the picture, a teacher is helping some students with their homework in the classroom.

make.prompt_cn: 猜一猜学生们为什么看起来很开心。
make.answer: The students look happy because the teacher is kind and their work is going well.

scenes.title: Library and reading
scenes.focus: 整体 → 人物动作 → 氛围 → 猜测
openers: Please describe the picture: students reading in a library.

shadow.en: Several students are sitting at a long table and reading quietly in the library.
shadow.cn: 几名学生正坐在长桌旁，在图书馆里安静地看书。
shadow.tip: quietly 重音在 QUI，library 重音在 LI。

shadow.en: A girl in the middle is taking notes from a thick book.
shadow.cn: 中间的一个女孩正在从一本厚书里做笔记。
shadow.tip: taking notes 连读，thick 注意 th。

shadow.en: The room looks peaceful because everyone is focused on their own study.
shadow.cn: 房间看起来很安静，因为每个人都专注于自己的学习。
shadow.tip: peaceful 重音在 PEACE，focused 重音在 FO。

make.prompt_cn: 照片里，几名学生正在图书馆安静地看书。
make.answer: In the picture, several students are reading quietly in the library.

make.prompt_cn: 描述坐在中间的女孩正在做什么。
make.answer: The girl sitting in the middle is taking notes from a big book.

scenes.title: Meals and restaurants
scenes.focus: 整体 → 人物 → 食物 → 猜测关系
openers: Please describe the picture: people eating together in a restaurant.

shadow.en: Three friends are sharing a pizza in a busy restaurant.
shadow.cn: 三个朋友正在一家热闹的餐厅里分享披萨。
shadow.tip: sharing 重音在 SHA，busy 重音在 BU。

shadow.en: The boy on the right is laughing while he holds a slice of pizza.
shadow.cn: 右边的男孩一边拿着披萨，一边大笑。
shadow.tip: laughing 尾音 ng，slice of 连读。

shadow.en: They seem relaxed because they are enjoying their free time together.
shadow.cn: 他们看起来很放松，因为正一起享受空闲时间。
shadow.tip: relaxed 重音在后，together 重音在 GE。

make.prompt_cn: 照片里，三个朋友正在餐厅一起吃披萨。
make.answer: In the picture, three friends are eating a pizza together in a restaurant.

make.prompt_cn: 描述右边男孩的表情和动作。
make.answer: The boy on the right is laughing and holding a slice of pizza in his hand.

scenes.title: Cooking at home
scenes.focus: 整体 → 分工 → 厨房物品 → 猜测菜品
openers: Please describe the picture: a family cooking in the kitchen.

shadow.en: A mother and her daughter are preparing dinner in a bright kitchen.
shadow.cn: 一位妈妈和女儿正在明亮的厨房里准备晚饭。
shadow.tip: preparing 重音在 PAR，bright 尾音 t 轻。

shadow.en: The mother is cutting vegetables while the girl is washing tomatoes at the sink.
shadow.cn: 妈妈在切菜，女孩在水槽边洗西红柿。
shadow.tip: vegetables 重音在 VEG，tomatoes 重音在 MA。

shadow.en: They are probably making a family meal because there are several dishes on the table.
shadow.cn: 他们大概在做一家人的饭，因为桌上已经有好几道菜。
shadow.tip: probably 三个音节，dishes 重音在 DISH。

make.prompt_cn: 照片里，妈妈和女儿正在厨房准备晚饭。
make.answer: In the picture, a mother and her daughter are preparing dinner in the kitchen.

make.prompt_cn: 说说她们可能在做什么菜，以及为什么。
make.answer: They are probably making soup because I can see vegetables and a large pot on the cooker.

scenes.title: Sports on the field
scenes.focus: 整体 → 动作 → 穿着 → 猜测比赛
openers: Please describe the picture: people playing sports outdoors.

shadow.en: Two boys are playing football on a grassy field while several classmates watch.
shadow.cn: 两个男孩正在草地上踢足球，几个同学在旁边看。
shadow.tip: football 重音在 FOOT，grassy 重音在 GRA。

shadow.en: The boy in the blue shirt is running towards the ball.
shadow.cn: 穿蓝衬衫的男孩正朝球跑去。
shadow.tip: towards 重音在后，ball 长音。

shadow.en: It looks like a school match because both teams are wearing the same colours.
shadow.cn: 看起来像学校比赛，因为两队穿着同色队服。
shadow.tip: looks like 连读，colours 重音在 CUL。

make.prompt_cn: 照片里，两个男孩正在草地上踢足球。
make.answer: In the picture, two boys are playing football on the grass.

make.prompt_cn: 描述穿蓝衬衫的男孩正在做什么。
make.answer: The boy in the blue shirt is running quickly towards the ball.

scenes.title: Cycling and skating
scenes.focus: 整体 → 人物 → 安全装备 → 猜测目的
openers: Please describe the picture: children riding bikes or skating.

shadow.en: A group of children are riding bicycles along a path in the park.
shadow.cn: 一群孩子正沿着公园的小路骑自行车。
shadow.tip: bicycles 重音在 BI，along a 连读。

shadow.en: The girl at the front is ringing her bell and smiling.
shadow.cn: 最前面的女孩一边按铃一边笑。

scenes.focus: 类型偏好 → 推荐 → 广告判断 → 结论
openers: What kind of films do you enjoy?
Do you believe advertisements?

shadow.en: I enjoy watching films with a good story because they make me think.
shadow.cn: 我喜欢看故事精彩的电影，因为它们让我思考。
shadow.tip: watching 重音在 WATCH，story 重音在 STO。

shadow.en: What about watching a comedy tonight? We have had a long week.
shadow.cn: 今晚看部喜剧怎么样？我们这周太累了。
shadow.tip: comedy 重音在 COM，tonight 重音在 NIGHT。

shadow.en: In my opinion, we should not believe everything we see in advertisements.
shadow.cn: 我认为我们不该相信广告里看到的一切。
shadow.tip: believe 重音在后，advertisements 重音在 VER。

make.prompt_cn: 你喜欢有精彩故事的电影，请说明理由。
make.answer: I enjoy watching films with a good story because they make me think and feel excited.

make.prompt_cn: 建议今晚看喜剧，因为大家这周很累。
make.answer: How about watching a comedy tonight? We have had a long week and need to relax.

scenes.title: Celebrations and parties
scenes.focus: 派对细节 → 地点 → 纪念方式 → 决定
openers: How should we celebrate the end of term?
Where should we have the party?

shadow.en: I think a birthday party is more fun when friends bring small gifts.
shadow.cn: 我认为朋友带小礼物会让生日派对更有趣。
shadow.tip: birthday 重音在 BIRTH，gifts 尾音 ts。

shadow.en: What about having the party in the park if the weather is nice?
shadow.cn: 如果天气好，在公园办派对怎么样？
shadow.tip: having 重音在 HA，weather 注意 th。

shadow.en: We could make a photo album together to remember the day.
shadow.cn: 我们可以一起做一本相册来纪念这一天。
shadow.tip: album 重音在 AL，remember 重音在 MEM。

make.prompt_cn: 你认为朋友带小礼物会让生日派对更有趣。
make.answer: I think a birthday party is more fun when friends bring small gifts and we open them together.

make.prompt_cn: 建议天气好时在公园办派对。
make.answer: If the weather is nice, we could have the party in the park.

scenes.title: Money and budgets
scenes.focus: 存钱 → 比价 → 列清单 → 选择
openers: How do you manage your pocket money?
How can we spend less?

shadow.en: I save part of my pocket money every month so that I can buy a present.
shadow.cn: 我每月存一部分零花钱，这样可以买礼物。
shadow.tip: pocket money 连读，present 重音在 PRES。

shadow.en: In my opinion, we should compare prices before we buy anything expensive.
shadow.cn: 我认为买贵东西前应该比较价格。
shadow.tip: compare 重音在后，expensive 重音在 PEN。

shadow.en: What about making a shopping list so that we do not waste money?
shadow.cn: 列一张购物清单怎么样，这样就不会浪费钱？
shadow.tip: shopping list 连读，waste 尾音 t 轻。

make.prompt_cn: 说说你怎样管理零花钱。
make.answer: I save part of my pocket money every month so that I can buy a present for my family.

make.prompt_cn: 建议买东西前比较价格。
make.answer: We should compare prices before we buy something expensive, because it helps us save money.

scenes.title: Technology and phones
scenes.focus: 好处 → 限制 → 专注方法 → 结论
openers: Do students need mobile phones at school?
How can we use phones well?

shadow.en: Mobile phones are useful for learning because we can look up new words quickly.
shadow.cn: 手机对学习很有用，因为能快速查生词。
shadow.tip: useful 重音在 USE，quickly 重音在 QUICK。

shadow.en: However, we should not use them for too long because it is bad for our eyes.
shadow.cn: 不过我们不该用太久，因为对眼睛不好。
shadow.tip: However 后稍停，eyes 双元音。

shadow.en: What about turning off notifications while we are doing homework?
shadow.cn: 做作业时关闭通知怎么样？
shadow.tip: notifications 重音在 CA，homework 重音在 HOME。

make.prompt_cn: 手机对学习有帮助，请说明理由。
make.answer: Mobile phones are useful for learning because we can look up new words and watch teaching videos.

make.prompt_cn: 建议做作业时关闭通知。
make.answer: What about turning off notifications while we are doing homework? It will help us focus.

scenes.title: Volunteering and helping others
scenes.focus: 志愿动机 → 具体经历 → 公益提议 → 决定
openers: Would you like to be a volunteer?
What can we do to help others?

shadow.en: I would like to be a volunteer because I enjoy helping other people.
shadow.cn: 我想当志愿者，因为我喜欢帮助别人。
shadow.tip: volunteer 重音在后，helping 重音在 HELP。

shadow.en: Last month I helped an old neighbour carry her shopping upstairs.
shadow.cn: 上个月我帮一位老邻居把买的东西搬上楼。
shadow.tip: neighbour 重音在 NEIGH，upstairs 重音在 STAIRS。

shadow.en: What about organising a book collection for children in the countryside?
shadow.cn: 为乡村儿童组织一次捐书活动怎么样？
shadow.tip: organising 重音在 OR，countryside 重音在 COUN。

make.prompt_cn: 你想当志愿者，请说明理由。
make.answer: I would like to be a volunteer because I enjoy helping others and making new friends.

make.prompt_cn: 建议为乡村儿童组织一次捐书活动。
make.answer: How about organising a book collection for children in the countryside?
